resume.description: Dynamic, results-driven Web Developer with hands-on experience, currently contributing to cross-functional feature deployments at SkilledUp Life. Proficient across both the MERN and PERN ecosystems, maintaining a comprehensive grasp of backend logic engineering, database integration, and UI frameworks including Vue.js, React, Next.js, Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Previously served as a Project Manager, leading multi-stakeholder technical squads and managing complex infrastructure. Proven track record of shipping scalable web applications across e-commerce and mobile platforms. Passionate about technical execution and agile team collaboration to deliver production-ready software solutions.
